contentAddressing.stability: identical judged evidence (gate/inputs/receipts/policy) must always bind identical artifactHashes[ref] bytes within the Run; enforced fail-closed by the packaged validator at record time
contentAddressing.contract: a diverging rewrite of the static per-gate ref for unchanged evidence is refused before it can orphan an earlier recorded pass (B-③, P2_4-r3); re-runs on genuinely changed evidence bind new bytes legitimately

semantics: R (D01): requirements closure and scope confirmation — goal, scope, non-goals, acceptance criteria and delivery target are closed and bound to the current open evidence before the run may leave the open checkpoint.
judgment: lib/delivery/gate.js evaluate (pure SDD.Gate.v1) over the payload's inputs/receipts/policy, reached only through bindings.mjs delegation; evidence admission refusals come from lib/delivery/evidence.js admitEvidence inside that evaluation.
